advice_items.quote: Rich people hire people and poor people don't. You got to create scale and create leverage.
advice_items.summary_en: Hire people to create scale and leverage instead of working in isolation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 雇人建立规模与杠杆，避免孤军奋战

advice_items.quote: Shortcut is mentorship. Now you minimize mistakes, you start to learn, got straight path forward in life. You need a mentor.
advice_items.summary_en: Seek a mentor as a shortcut to minimize mistakes and accelerate learning.
advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找导师作为捷径，少走弯路快速成长

advice_items.quote: You can always fix broke, but you can't fix poverty. Poverty is a mindset.
advice_items.summary_en: Separate temporary lack of money from a poverty mindset; financial hardship is fixable if your mindset isn't limiting.
advice_items.summary_zh: 穷困可解而贫穷心态难治，重塑思维格局

advice_items.quote: What you got left is what you got left. Live each day as a life in miniature, live it on steroids, and wake up with gratitude. Thank God I got today.
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize how limited your remaining time is, wake up grateful to God, and live every day to the fullest.
advice_items.summary_zh: 认清生命有限，每日心怀感恩全力以赴

guests.first_money_or_break: 仅上过社区大学，曾穷到连免费邮票都买不起；后投身金融行业并通过雇人建立团队杠杆，单年最高收入达65万美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 寻找导师减少试错、雇佣他人放大自身杠杆，摆脱贫穷心态并心怀感恩过好每一天。

advice_items.quote: People have a first little taste of success and they get scared thinking I don't want to lose what I've made... Don't be scared to lose what you finally made, go reinvest it.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't become timid after your first taste of success; stay aggressive and reinvest earnings to scale from $1M to $10M.
advice_items.summary_zh: 小有所成后别怕失去，继续积极再投资扩大规模

advice_items.quote: It takes money to make money, right? So go out there and buy that house, buy that second property, buy the investment property.
advice_items.summary_en: Put earned profits to work by buying real estate and investment properties.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用赚到的钱购买房产与投资性物业实现钱生钱

advice_items.quote: Make God a part of your life... without my faith, without God blessing all that I've done, there would be no success.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep faith and God at the center of your life and business, especially to endure tough times.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将信仰放在首位，依靠信念撑过创业低谷

guests.first_money_or_break: 在眼镜与助听器行业创业，此前单年最高收入约150万美元；30岁成为百万富翁，并在美国航空申请破产时承接了1.3万名当地员工抢在医保失效前配助听器的需求，单年收入飙升至1670万美元。
guests.guest_name: Dallas Eyeglass & Hearing Aid Business Owner (43yo)
guests.zero_start_advice: 赚到第一笔钱后不要保守畏缩，要敢于继续投入资金购买房产等资产扩大规模，并在事业中保持信仰。

advice_items.quote: They don't take no for an answer. 90% of people when they're told no they just kind of say okay and they turn away. The successful people, they find a way to get the yes.
advice_items.summary_en: Refuse to accept rejection as the final answer; persist until you find a way to get a yes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不轻言放弃，面对拒绝想方设法争取到“行”

advice_items.quote: Stay away from the clubs and the bottle service and all the money. I went through that and wasted a lot of money and time and effort.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid wasting money, time, and energy on nightclubs and bottle service in your twenties; prioritize long-term financial security and freedom.
advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时远离夜店挥霍，把钱和时间留给未来自由

advice_items.quote: Set goals, and I still do it to this day, the one, three, and five... stay focused, stay strong, grind it out.
advice_items.summary_en: Set 1-, 3-, and 5-year goals to fuel motivation, stay focused, and relentlessly grind it out.
advice_items.summary_zh: 制定1/3/5年目标保持专注，咬牙死磕到底

guests.first_money_or_break: 29岁时身无分文搬回父母家，没有手机和支票账户；随后进入保险行业深耕15年，逆袭成为千万富翁级企业家。
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要在夜店等享乐消费上浪费金钱与时间，设定1年、3年、5年目标，面对拒绝不屈服，专注拼搏。

advice_items.quote: Change is reality and change equals opportunity. If I respond to this change and others don't, I'm going to turn that into shareholder value.
advice_items.summary_en: Treat change as inevitable opportunity; responding positively faster than competitors creates shareholder value.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将变化视为机遇，快人一步应对就能创造价值

advice_items.quote: Confidence is all about preparation, so the more you prepare, the more you can win.
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome fear of change by preparing thoroughly, because preparation is the true source of confidence.
advice_items.summary_zh: 自信源于充分准备，准备越充分胜算越大

advice_items.quote: Break complex things down into simple solutions... Clarity comes from inbound communications, listening well, and outbound communications, keeping things simple.
advice_items.summary_en: Lead effectively by listening well and distilling complex problems into simple, clear solutions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善于倾听并将复杂问题简化，保持清晰沟通

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: In the corporate world it's not salary... it's all about equity. Always take advantage of the equity programs... that was the true creation of wealth.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't rely on corporate salary alone; participate aggressively in company equity programs to build real wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 职场致富靠股权而非死工资，积极参与股权计划

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身马萨诸塞州没有自来水的简陋木屋，靠政府救济奶酪长大，职场初期难以按时付清账单；后一路晋升为7-Eleven及百事达CEO，并在7-Eleven出售时凭借积累的股票真正实现财富跃迁。
guests.role_or_title: Former CEO of 7-Eleven & Former Chairman/CEO of Blockbuster
guests.zero_start_advice: 职场不要只看重月薪，务必尽一切可能买入并持有公司股权；同时学会拥抱变化、充分准备以建立自信，并用简单清晰的沟通去领导团队。
